name: first_strike_pvp_floor
objective: On Odin's globally first hostile land contact, replace an inefficient 10-percent probe with the smallest safe same-target legal commitment that reaches the attack-size-dependent PvP loss floor.

parent.normalization: The parent carries the mandatory K1Z Gravity identity repair while preserving the live v89 selector outside that safety fix.

source_evidence.formula: DefaultConfig.attackLogic blends a 60-percent current-loss term with a 40-percent alternate term. Only the current-loss term depends on attack size; its defenderTroops / attackTroops factor clamps at 0.6, so that term reaches its minimum at attackTroops >= defenderTroops / 0.6, exactly 5/3. The alternate term is attack-size independent, and speed reaches its separate floor earlier at attackTroops >= defenderTroops.

guard: The exact parent has selected an unmarked 10-percent rival land attack on a resolved, unprotected, non-K1Z target.
No prior non-neutral rival land attack exists anywhere in the episode history.
At most 100 active decisions have occurred, preventing the capped 320-entry history from ever rearming the one-shot guard.
The target tile share is at most 0.12.
Own troop ratio is at least 0.90.
There is no current incoming pressure through either incomingAttacks or allProtocolAttackerIDs.
The parent action is below the 5/3 attack-troop floor.
A non-high-risk, unavoided 25- or 40-percent legal action against the same target clears the floor using exact action troops and targetTroops metadata.
isolated_change.action: Replace only the parent's percentage with the smallest same-target safe legal 25- or 40-percent commitment whose exact metadata troops is at least 5/3 of targetTroops.
preserved: every later hostile contact and all continued-target 25/40 escalation
all behavior below 0.90 own troop ratio or under incoming pressure
all behavior when no legal percentage clears the floor

deduplication.gr1_ef2_pg2: Changed neutral-opening commitment, not hostile first-contact efficiency.
deduplication.retired_rf1: RF1 was a rejected 1.10 reserve-floor arm. PF1 does not suppress attacks or reuse that codename; it changes at most one globally first hostile commitment after the parent has already chosen the target.
deduplication.v23_v24_v25: Tested reserve caps on hostile commitments. PF1 raises at most one globally first weak-target commitment while reserve is at least 0.90 and leaves continuation escalation unchanged.
deduplication.tpl1: Bundled the L2 floor inside a full replacement chassis, so its matched loss did not isolate this variable.
deduplication.fc1: Covered continued-target finish continuity after an established attack streak, not first contact.

gates.red_fixture: A committed canonical fixture built from the hash-bound R589 turn-4900 evidence must make exact parent select unmarked attack:idjkf73n:10; PF1 must select attack:idjkf73n:25 with marker pf1.
lock_ins: A low-reserve version of the same state remains 10 percent.
Incoming pressure preserves the parent action.
A protected K1Z target is never selected.
Any prior hostile land contact, including against a different rival, permanently disables PF1 inside its bounded decision window.
A continued target preserves the parent's 25/40 escalation.
A first contact after 100 active decisions preserves the parent action.
A first contact with missing exact metadata or no floor-clearing safe legal percentage preserves the parent action.
When both 25 and 40 percent clear the floor, PF1 selects 25; when only 40 clears, PF1 selects 40.
gates.mechanism: The exact linux/amd64 candidate must reach pf1 with accepted decisions, zero unexplained holds or rejects, no second PF1 reroute in an episode, and zero K1Z harm.
gates.matched: A pinned candidate-parent seat swap must show strictly better aggregate placement points; tiles and time-to-remove the marked weak targets are secondary. A tie or loss rejects PF1.
gates.hosted: Current-roster diagnostic must finish 4/4 with actual Odin wins before regression.
gates.regression: A separate 20/20 map-and-seat gate and final fail-closed RCI are required before automatic league submission.

failure_conditions: The exact red fixture cannot be materialized without invented state.
PF1 changes target identity, stacks over a parent marker, or fires outside the preregistered boundary.
PF1 fires more than once in an episode, chooses 25 when it does not clear the floor, or chooses 40 when 25 clears.
Any K1Z harm, unexplained hold, rejection, or source/image mismatch occurs.
The matched pair does not improve aggregate placement points.
